Three ways to get ahead

Ranked by impact, and every one comes from a number above rather than an opinion. Three is what a shop your size can actually get done, so these are the three with the most evidence behind them, not one for each area.

Every one of the five is on it with their prices and their reviews showing. You are not on it at all. This is the shelf your customers are standing in front of, and you are not on the shelf.

Start your Booksy listing

One sitting · Booksy is £40 a month, plus £5 a month for each extra person. Read from their pricing page on 14 September.

Before you start: your bookings run through NearCut, and we have not checked whether the two can run side by side. Put that question to Booksy on the page above before you set anything up, because two diaries is a bigger job than one listing.

2 Reviews & reputation

Ask every customer to review you by name, starting this week

There are 4,799 reviews across the five of them on Booksy, and none about you anywhere we can read. All five sit at 5.0, so you cannot beat them on score. But four of the nine reviews we read name the barber, not the shop, and that is what makes somebody book the same person again. Ask for your name in it.

What this is based on
  • HINCES 2,461, The Fade Inn 1,051, NO.1 607, Barbering AJ 351, Fish Street 329
  • You: none found, on any platform we could reach
  • All five rated 5.0, so there is no complaint pattern to exploit
  • 4 of the 9 reviews we read name an individual barber rather than the shop
  • 5 of the 9 are returning customers, and none mentions switching from anywhere
  • Source
  • booksy.com, read 14 September

An ongoing habit, not a one-off. We have not given you a link yet, because you are not on Booksy and Fresha has you as “call to book”, so today there is nowhere for that review to land. That is the next thing we are fixing.
